# Deploy AWS Lambda

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs. Edit the manifest, then run `make docs`. -->

Update Lambda function code from an image, zip, or S3 object and move an alias

```yaml
- uses: patrickisgreat/actions-toolkit/actions/deploy-aws-lambda@v1
  with:
    function-name: # Lambda function name or ARN.
```

## How it works

Update a Lambda function's code and, optionally, publish an immutable version behind an
alias.

Three source shapes, because real repos use all three:
  • `image`     — a container image URI (the usual pairing with docker-build-push)
  • `zip-file`  — a local zip uploaded directly (fine under ~50 MB)
  • `s3-bucket` + `s3-key` — a zip already in S3 (required above the direct-upload limit)

Publishing a version and moving an alias is the deploy pattern worth defaulting to:
`$LATEST` is mutable and gives you nothing to roll back to, whereas `alias → version N`
makes rollback a single alias update. Set `alias` to turn it on.

Authenticate with `aws-auth` first.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `function-name` | **yes** | — | Lambda function name or ARN. |
| `image` | no | `""` | Container image URI. Mutually exclusive with the zip inputs. |
| `zip-file` | no | `""` | Path to a local deployment zip. |
| `s3-bucket` | no | `""` | Bucket holding the deployment zip. |
| `s3-key` | no | `""` | Key of the deployment zip. |
| `publish` | no | `true` | true to publish an immutable version after updating the code. |
| `alias` | no | `""` | Alias to point at the newly published version. Empty skips alias handling. |
| `environment-variables` | no | `""` | Newline-separated `KEY=value` pairs merged into the function's environment. Existing variables not listed are preserved. |
| `memory-size` | no | `""` | Override memory in MB. Empty leaves it unchanged. |
| `timeout` | no | `""` | Override timeout in seconds. Empty leaves it unchanged. |
| `wait` | no | `true` | true to wait for the update to finish before returning. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `version` | The published version number, or `$LATEST` when `publish` is false. |
| `function-arn` | ARN of the deployed function (qualified with the version when published). |
| `alias-arn` | ARN of the alias, when one was set. |
